name: FuelScout
description: Cheapest fuel nearby for agents: station-level prices for Spain, France and Italy and official EIA regional averages for the US, optionally ranked by all-in cost including the detour. Plain GET with free previews; USDC 0.01 per query over x402 on Base, Arbitrum or Polygon, or XRP/RLUSD on the XRP Ledger. A2A 0.3.0 JSON-RPC at https://fuelscout.scalpstream.com/a2a, OpenAPI at https://fuelscout.scalpstream.com/openapi.json. Official open data, may be delayed.
